profile_text.body:
IBM is a public technology company founded in 1911 and headquartered in Armonk, New York. According to its website, IBM describes OpenPages as a "highly scalable, AI-powered, and unified GRC platform" that helps organizations manage risk, compliance, and audit functions in one integrated solution. The platform offers a modular approach to governance, risk, and compliance, deployable on any cloud or on-premises environment, and includes an interactive workspace called the GRC Canvas for visualizing and managing risk with live data. IBM reports that IDC recognized it as a leader in AI-enabled financial governance, risk, and compliance.

IBM's AI governance products include IBM OpenPages with Watson, which combines risk assessment and regulatory mapping with Watson AI-automated documentation, and IBM watsonx.governance, an AI lifecycle governance tool for model evaluation, monitoring, and documentation that includes EU AI Act accelerators. Watsonx.governance was named a Leader in Gartner's first AI Governance Platforms Magic Quadrant in June 2026. The company's broader watsonx enterprise AI platform supports agent inventory, behavior monitoring, and hallucination detection through a model-agnostic architecture. OpenPages includes an MCP Server for enabling AI agents to create, query, and update GRC objects.

IBM reported revenue of $67.535 billion for the year ending December 31, 2025. The company maintains significant legal exposure, with 342 cases tracked in New York. IBM operates as a public company under ticker IBM with CIK 0000051143.
